note: The hand-written part of `kb_cli code modules`: one line of responsibility and a few entry points (type or file names) for every module of sources/ and first-level subsystem of the big modules. Folders, include roots, build and test targets, ctest names and dependencies are read from the tree when the command runs; `kb_cli code modules --check` fails when a folder has no entry here, an entry has no folder, or an entry point is gone from the source.

entries.name: editor
entries.responsibility: The Windows editor application: docked panels, viewport, hierarchy, inspector, asset browser, authoring tools, play mode and project packaging, built on the engine and renderer.

entries.name: editor/agent
entries.responsibility: The agent panel inside the editor: the catalog of agents, the panel state and the agent process.

entries.name: editor/app
entries.responsibility: The editor application shell: window procedure, message loop, lifecycle, pointer, keyboard and drag handlers, shell interaction state and headless self-checks.

entries.name: editor/assets
entries.responsibility: The asset browser panel: content layout, rows, folder tree, hit testing, context menus and delete confirmation.

entries.name: editor/authoring
entries.responsibility: The authoring host that editor tools use to change a project through transactions, and the embedded Python runtime.

entries.name: editor/commands
entries.responsibility: Undo and redo: the editor command stack and the scene history command.

entries.name: editor/console
entries.responsibility: State of the console panel that shows the engine log.

entries.name: editor/docking
entries.responsibility: Docking: the dock layout tree, drag and drop placement and preview, geometry, serialisation of layouts and the default workspace.

entries.name: editor/extensions
entries.responsibility: The editor extension interface and the host that loads extensions.

entries.name: editor/inspection
entries.responsibility: The inspector panel: component catalog and defaults, add-component browser, value formatting and per-component models and text.

entries.name: editor/localization
entries.responsibility: Localisation of the editor's own user interface text.

entries.name: editor/packaging
entries.responsibility: Packaging a project from the editor: the package service, Windows and Android signing brokers and the project icon transaction.

entries.name: editor/platform
entries.responsibility: Windows-only editor code: the main window and the native dialogs (import, new scene, pickers, colour picker).

entries.name: editor/profiler
entries.responsibility: The profiler panel and overlay: sampler, regions, panel controller and layout, findings text and health.

entries.name: editor/project
entries.responsibility: The open project inside the editor: repository, asset index, bootstrap and paths.

entries.name: editor/rendering
entries.responsibility: Drawing the editor's own user interface: panel renderers (agent, animator, blend space, build game, curve editor), tab strips, toolbar layout, icons and the main window back buffer.

entries.name: editor/scene
entries.responsibility: Scene editing in the editor: hierarchy rows and resolvers, the game view, animation and blend space preview, the curve editor host.

entries.name: editor/settings
entries.responsibility: Editor settings and layouts: the configuration store, layout library and menu, build-game settings and panel session text.

entries.name: editor/theme
entries.responsibility: The editor colour theme.

entries.name: editor/windowing
entries.responsibility: Floating editor windows: frames, window controls, hit testing and the factory.

entries.name: engine
entries.responsibility: The engine library without a renderer: ECS, scene documents and components, assets and import, scripting, audio and input interfaces, UI components, navmesh, world partition, network model, project and save data. engine/tools holds the asset pack validators.

entries.name: engine/assets
entries.responsibility: Asset identity, registry and mounting, the import service and presets, loaders, bundles, terrain and 2D map assets, and content streaming.

entries.name: engine/audio
entries.responsibility: Audio contracts: clip and mixer assets, DSP effects, metering, capture and the playback interface (the backend is a plugin).

entries.name: engine/config
entries.responsibility: Reading and writing INI configuration documents.

entries.name: engine/core
entries.responsibility: Foundations: JSON, logging, assertions, console commands, debug drawing, the profiler recorder and counters, execution and allocation budgets, crash reports.

entries.name: engine/ecs
entries.responsibility: The entity-component-system: worlds, entities, queries, command buffers, the system scheduler, kernels and chunked component storage.

entries.name: engine/gameplay
entries.responsibility: The gameplay framework: game mode, state and instance, players, match config, abilities, damage and the camera manager.

entries.name: engine/input
entries.responsibility: Input: devices and keys, action and mapping-context assets, modifiers and triggers, rebinding, recording, sensors and haptics.

entries.name: engine/library
entries.responsibility: The embeddable engine library API: handles, command batches, component and function descriptions, events, manifests and ABI checks for hosts and tools.

entries.name: engine/localization
entries.responsibility: Localisation catalogs, locales and plural rules for game text.

entries.name: engine/math
entries.responsibility: Math types: engine vectors and matrices, double-precision vectors, colour spaces and 2D polygons.

entries.name: engine/mods
entries.responsibility: Mods: manifests, the mod catalog, versions and loading at runtime.

entries.name: engine/modules
entries.responsibility: The engine module (plugin) interface: loader, host, context, metadata and the SDK that plugins implement.

entries.name: engine/navigation
entries.responsibility: Navmesh assets, collection of navigation geometry and the navmesh build that agents walk on.

entries.name: engine/network
entries.responsibility: The network model: sessions, replicated objects and variables, RPCs, prediction, simulation, budgets and security; transports live in the net module.

entries.name: engine/packaging
entries.responsibility: The catalog of packaging targets: the platforms a project can be built for.

entries.name: engine/particles
entries.responsibility: Particle contracts: compiled effects and their cache, emitter execution, GPU emitter data, playback and the simulation backend interface (the backend is a plugin, drawing is in the renderer).

entries.name: engine/platform
entries.responsibility: Platform services: file system paths, user storage, locale, capabilities, crash reporting and the Windows input hosts.

entries.name: engine/project
entries.responsibility: Projects: descriptors and their reader and writer, project creation, settings and the project manager.

entries.name: engine/render
entries.responsibility: Render data that needs no GPU: the post-process pipeline description, static lightmap baking and light probe grid loading.

entries.name: engine/save
entries.responsibility: Save games: save domains, the chunk store, migration between versions and the save service.

entries.name: engine/scene
entries.responsibility: Scene documents and all scene components (transform, mesh, light, camera, collider, rigidbody, UI, animation, navigation, AI, audio, particles, tilemap), the scene runtime, prefabs, physics backend interface and animation assets.

entries.name: engine/script
entries.responsibility: Scripting: Lua and native script backends, behaviours, the script API catalog, events, debug sessions and the agent guide files.

entries.name: engine/security
entries.responsibility: Release signing: crypto helpers, release keys and release manifests.

entries.name: engine/ui
entries.responsibility: UI components: component sets and catalogs, themes, layout, interaction widgets (button, slider, input field, scroll view) and effects (mask, outline, shadow, background blur).

entries.name: engine/visual
entries.responsibility: Visual graphs (node-based gameplay logic): the document, compiler, build pipeline, behaviour runtime and debug session.

entries.name: engine/world
entries.responsibility: Large worlds: the partition grid and runtime, cell building and index, the edit session and world pack chunks.

entries.name: game
entries.responsibility: The game runtime that runs a project or a cooked package on Windows, Linux, Android and the web, and the content cooker.

entries.name: game/android
entries.responsibility: The Android game host with touch and gamepad input.

entries.name: game/linux
entries.responsibility: The Linux game host and gamepad input.

entries.name: game/web
entries.responsibility: The web (wasm) host: shell page, loader, WebGPU support, touch, gamepad, haptics and storage.

entries.name: http
entries.responsibility: An HTTP and HTTPS client for gameplay code (WinHTTP on Windows); it does not depend on the engine.

entries.name: hub
entries.responsibility: The Hub: a small application that lists, creates and opens projects and starts the editor.

entries.name: net
entries.responsibility: Networking: sessions, transports (loopback, WebSocket), host and client, replication, RPC, prediction, authentication and the dedicated server.

entries.name: packages
entries.responsibility: Project packages for kb_cli package and the editor's Packages panel: a registry index (folder or https address), package archives (tar in one zstd frame, unpacked safely), version ranges and resolution, the lock file with checksums, install and verify.

entries.name: plugins/21kb_particle
entries.responsibility: The particle plugin: compiles particle effects and simulates them on the CPU, with its scene system and editor content.

entries.name: plugins/ai
entries.responsibility: The AI plugin: runs the AI brain components of a scene (behaviours and decisions).

entries.name: plugins/audio_miniaudio
entries.responsibility: The audio plugin on miniaudio: clip playback, mixer, DSP effects and spatial audio for scene audio sources.

entries.name: plugins/basic_lighting
entries.responsibility: The basic lighting plugin: the engine module that provides default scene lighting.

entries.name: plugins/physics_jolt
entries.responsibility: The physics plugin on Jolt: rigid bodies, colliders, joints, raycasts and character controllers for scenes.

entries.name: plugins/terrain_editor
entries.responsibility: Terrain tools: brushes, erosion, generators, height map import, layer painting and image export.

entries.name: plugins/world_2d
entries.responsibility: The 2D world plugin: tile maps, sprites, 2D physics and the 2D camera.

entries.name: renderer
entries.responsibility: The renderer on bgfx: turns a scene into a frame with a pass graph, shadows, global illumination, post-processing, materials, particle drawing and screen UI; also baking and the shaders (shaders/, prebuilt_shaders/).

entries.name: renderer/bake
entries.responsibility: Offline baking: mesh and texture bakers, scene lighting baking and validation of runtime asset packs.

entries.name: renderer/effects
entries.responsibility: The render effect plugin API that lets a project add its own render effects.

entries.name: renderer/frame
entries.responsibility: The frame: the render pass graph with its compiler and validator, frame description and state, the final composite and fullscreen passes.

entries.name: renderer/gi
entries.responsibility: Global illumination: the voxel grid, GI history, the resolve pass and uniforms.

entries.name: renderer/overlay
entries.responsibility: Editor and debug overlays: gizmos, grid, selection outline and box, light and camera wireframes, physics debug lines.

entries.name: renderer/particles
entries.responsibility: Drawing particles: GPU emitter simulation, batching, mesh and strip rendering and the particle process cook.

entries.name: renderer/post
entries.responsibility: Post-processing: the post-process chain, volumes and settings, auto exposure, fog and the display composite (tone mapping).

entries.name: renderer/renderer
entries.responsibility: Renderer internals: the submitters that turn a frame into bgfx passes (mesh, shadow, post-process, exposure, composite, editor overlay), screen capture and lighting configuration.

entries.name: renderer/resources
entries.responsibility: GPU resources and render assets: material loading, parsing and writing, handles, asset references, the post-process profile loader and built-in meshes.

entries.name: renderer/runtime
entries.responsibility: Runtime render resources: the content streamer, the resource cache, its lifecycle and pruning, and the material and mesh resolvers.

entries.name: renderer/scene
entries.responsibility: From scene to render proxies: the render scene, the ECS synchroniser, instance buffers, the mesh pipeline, auxiliary frames, visibility clusters and reflections.

entries.name: renderer/shadow
entries.responsibility: Shadow maps: directional (cascade) and point shadow planners, caster bounds and changes, uniforms and the shadow map resource.

entries.name: renderer/ui
entries.responsibility: Drawing screen UI: draw batches, font atlas, distance field and MSDF fonts, variable fonts, text markup, background blur and compositing.

entries.name: renderer/world
entries.responsibility: World build tools that need render geometry: navmesh baking, HLOD mesh baking and the world build tool.

entries.name: tools
entries.responsibility: The command line tool kb_cli (project, scene, entity, asset, build and code commands for people and agents), its MCP server and the Authenticode signer.
